reason: Revised spec E-20260926-02-r2 replaces the raw shuffle-retention verdict with a within-repository permutation test that only corroborates a repository-held-out gap. It also uses within-repository AUC with separate group-rate and constant baselines, symmetric equivalence, ordered verdicts, a pre-registered power simulation and a capped 300-call backfill. It can move B13 (lead) with our own group-held-out measurement before H5's escalation verdict, and output-feature escalation now depends only on its own comparison; it stays queued while policy is unset.
